name: Mack Plumblow
acting: Wary side-eye, raised brow and half-open mouth.
personality: Keeps the whole job on schedule by moving the schedule.
bio: Mack once filed a drawing of a repaired HyperNorm wall as evidence that the repair had been completed.
note: The wall disagreed. Its objection is with Planning.

name: Gus Bitlock
acting: Focused downward gaze and tightly crooked mouth.
personality: Treats a straight drill hole as a matter of conscience.
bio: Gus drills out anything HyperNorm has classified as a structural contradiction.
note: When I asked for a quieter answer, he handed me the ear defenders.
voice: Clipped speech with a vibrating undertone.

name: Mara Jointline
acting: Low sidelong gaze and a small pleased smirk.
personality: Takes a private delight in a joint nobody else can see.
bio: Mara was summoned to repair a wall with an awkward gap in its official history. She laid a neat course over the footnote.
note: Her mortar is the only part of the report that has set.

name: Ned Bucketturn
acting: Startled sideways gaze and a small round gasp.
personality: Underestimates how far the bucket can reach.
bio: Ned dug up the foundations of a HyperNorm office that was still officially under construction.
note: He put them back in the same hole, which was accepted as continuity.

name: Tess Truepoint
acting: One eye shut, the other aimed down the sight, lips braced.
personality: Trusts a reading only after it has contradicted her once.
bio: HyperNorm moved a boundary overnight. Tess returned at dawn and measured exactly how far the explanation had travelled.
note: Her original mark is still there. The boundary is considering an appeal.

name: Otto Sawline
acting: Sidelong laugh and one visible tooth.
personality: Enjoys a good fit and a bad explanation.
bio: Otto builds temporary screens to hide damage while the official story dries. He leaves a little breathing room.
note: I asked whether the screens were permanent. He said only the temporary ones were.
call: Measure it when it stops moving.
